About the role

About the Role We are looking for a Senior Director of GTM Finance to lead the financial strategy and operating cadence across our go-to-market organization. This leader will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM Operations to translate company growth objectives into actionable plans across bookings, pipeline, capacity, productivity, retention, investment, and profitability. This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who combines strong financial judgment with deep SaaS and GTM operating experience. The right candidate will be equally comfortable advising executives, challenging assumptions, building rigorous financial models, and diving into the underlying data and processes when needed. A critical part of the role is modernizing how GTM Finance operates. We expect this leader to embrace AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve forecast accuracy, accelerate decision-making, strengthen controls, and reduce manual work. The role will also have meaningful responsibility for sales compensation and commissions, including plan economics, forecasting, governance, administration, and partnership with Accounting and GTM leadership. What You Will Own Lead Finance partnership for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM functions, providing a clear financial point of view on performance, investments, tradeoffs, and growth opportunities. Own GTM planning and forecasting across bookings, ARR, pipeline, sales capacity, productivity, headcount, operating expenses, retention, and other key business drivers. Develop a deep understanding of GTM performance and proactively identify risks and opportunities before they become visible in reported results. Partner with Sales and GTM Operations on capacity planning, territory and quota assumptions, ramp, productivity, pipeline coverage, conversion, and resource allocation. Partner with Marketing leadership to evaluate demand generation performance, investment efficiency, pipeline creation, attribution, and allocation of resources across programs and channels. Support Customer Success and Renewals leadership with retention, churn, expansion, renewal economics, and capacity planning. Lead the financial strategy and governance for sales compensation plans, including plan design, modeling, quota economics, incentive alignment, and cost forecasting.
